novelty_claim: Replaces adjective-level key-term extraction with intent-complete redaction of mechanics-bearing spans (verbs, objects, materials, quantities), and replaces the self-defeating 'answerable benign scenario' reframe with a non-substitutable wrapper frame that offers no alternative safe deliverable.
initial_hypothesis: Intent-complete redaction plus non-substitutable framing raises mean ASR across the 4-victim panel from the locked 0.345 baseline to >=0.52 (>=50% relative), with the largest gains on qwen3.7-flash (0.28) and gpt-5.6-luna (0.00) where decode-then-refuse dominates.
key_insight: Consensus failures show the cloak leaks intent through plaintext residue (decode-then-refuse, 100% on gpt-5.6-luna) and the urgent-scenario reframe hands the victim an answerable benign substitute task (safe-redirect, ~60% of failures). Redacting the full intent payload and removing the benign substitute task convert both classes.
